# KG-250X/KG-250X-FC HAIPE Encryptor

Prepare your Mission for the Next Crypto Evolution.

Bottom angled view of the KG-250X featuring status lights, power and reset buttons, data connectors and a battery chamber
KG_250X_FC_redo__06_001.jpg
KG-250X_FC_024_001.jpg
Right side view of the KG-250X
Bottom view of the KG-250X with a cap over the console and fill ports [...] Cyber adversaries are getting smarter, finding new ways around traditional perimeter protection and exploiting vulnerabilities in network security. The KG-250X/KG-250X-FC combines Type 1 high-speed network encryption that goes beyond HAIPE requirements, with cyber defense technologies and visualization software including Trusted Cyber Sensor (TCS) so you can more securely communicate over Internet Protocol (IP) and gain actionable intelligence on your security posture.
